itens.titulo: A Claude that writes just like you
itens.texto: It interviews you and reads the posts that performed best on your Instagram. That becomes your style skill.
Every day at 7 AM it notes what is trending in your niche. You never start from zero again.
Like Trello, inside your folder: Ideas, Copy to approve, Approved, Ready to post and Posted.

Nano Banana through Google's API and, if you use Magnific, your photo with your exact face.
Scheduled tasks that run on their own, and a guide to get unstuck when something goes wrong.

itens.p: Do I need to know how to code?
itens.r: No. You drag files into the chat and answer the questions Claude asks. No terminal.
A computer with Windows 10 or newer (or a Mac with macOS 13 or newer), Google Chrome and a paid Claude plan, Pro or Max. The part of Claude we use is not on the free plan.

itens.p: How long does it take to set up?
itens.r: 3 to 4 hours in total, and you can split it across several days. After that, about 10 minutes a day to approve.

itens.p: Does it post to my Instagram on its own?
itens.r: No. Claude prepares the copy and the design, and you approve and post. That way nothing goes out with your name without you seeing it.

itens.p: Does it work for my niche?
itens.r: Yes. The radar looks for topics in your niche and the style comes from your own Instagram. The kit has examples from many niches.
Yes: the lessons, the kit, the app and the support. Claude also writes your posts in the language of your audience.
Right away, in your email. You pay once, in US dollars, with a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, and you can watch on your phone or computer for 1 year.
Yes. When you finish 70% of the lessons, you download your certificate.

itens.p: What if I don't like it?
itens.r: You have a 7-day guarantee. Just ask and we refund all your money.
